name: Deadly Surprise (Combat)
body:
When you take up an unorthodox weapon in combat, you attack with surprising lethality.

Prerequisite(s): Catch Off-Guard, sneak attack class feature

Benefit: The first attack you make using each improvised weapon in a battle denies your opponent of their Dexterity bonus to AC (whether or not they are armed). In addition, your sneak attack damage from attacks with improvised weapons increases by 1d6.
